protocol_definition.zres_freeze_rationale: Hard-freezing layers strictly deeper than z_res = lambda_max / 3 is disabled by default because fundamental-mode Rayleigh sensitivity kernels retain substantial weight in (lambda_max / 3, 2 * lambda_max / 3]; strict lambda_max / 3 freezing traps deeper-band prior bias and degrades shallow resolvable-depth Vs RMSE by 13-22 percentage points.
